==Description==
The '''Swarm''', in-game referred to as '''Swarm 1''' despite there only being one Swarm enemy, was a four-legged enemy that was spawned from the [[Carrier]] when it died. It was faster than the [[Carrier]] and had more health than the [[Molten]].  The '''Swarm''' created a bubble when it died, and any towers caught in it were stunned. This was similar to the [[Carrier]], although the bubble was smaller.

==Appearance==
Compared to the average enemy, the '''Swarm''' had quite an unusual design as it had four dark green legs, with black claws. It was smaller than the [[Carrier]]. It had a long green neck that was bent and glowing green eyes. It had a zombie face that was not seen on any other enemy. It did not have any arms.

==Strategy==
*The bubble that the '''Swarm''' creates upon its death will not destroy or stun any [[units]] from the [[Military Base]] or [[Crook Boss]] if any of them are caught in the bubble.
**This makes them very useful when other towers are stunned.
*The [[Rocketeer|Rocketer]] can be very useful against the '''Swarm''' due to its splash damage.
*Long range towers, such as the [[Ranger|Outlaw]] and [[Sniper]], are effective against the '''Swarm''' as they can shoot it from a distance. This means that they are less likely to be caught in the bubble when the '''Swarm''' dies.
*The bubble created by the '''Swarm''' can be completely avoided by towers.
**Try not to kill the '''Swarm''' next to your towers.
*If required, you can use the [[Freezer]]'s ''Ice Drop'' ability to stop the '''Swarm''' in its track, even if the [[Freezer]] is stunned.

==Trivia==
*In-game, the '''Swarm''' was called ''Swarm 1'', even though there was no ''Swarm 2''.
*This enemy could possibly be a reference to the ''Mutant Creeper'' mob from a ''Minecraft'' mod.
